lockFileMaintenance.description: Weekly uv.lock refresh. It also moves horae-sdk to the latest commit of the core's main: pyproject.toml takes it from the branch and uv.lock pins the commit. A git commit has no release timestamp, so the 7-day age cannot apply: review that bump like any dependency.

customManagers.description: Tool versions pinned in workflow env vars (gitleaks, uv): a `# renovate:` comment line followed by NAME_VERSION: x.y.z (no leading v). A gitleaks bump also needs GITLEAKS_SHA256 updated by hand; until then the checksum step fails closed.
